issue.title: Failed measurements evade the command budget
issue.promotion_reason: current contained failing evidence is repeatable or deterministically sufficient and satisfies the frozen plan

root_cause_group.claim: Failed measurements omit executed commands from durable counters, permitting later work against an understated command total.

theories.claim: Failed candidate or regression-set measurements do not charge commands, warmups, or samples already executed, allowing later optimization cycles to admit work beyond the configured immutable command budget.
theories.basis: The optimization loop increments measurement counters only after successful measurements, while measurement-error branches continue without charging attempted commands; cycle admission relies on state.Counters.Commands (qa-v1-block-af5f117594728fd0aab939e2, qa-v1-block-3bf230d4d7d4d3f748ebe877). Governed requirements require immutable maxima and bounded expensive work (qa-v1-block-ce45392d2ebc036986b89d13, qa-v1-block-d19e106aa8552aa77a4f6b06).
theories.verification_surface: Inspect and deterministically test counter accounting and cycle admission in internal/sprint/performance_optimize_runtime.go using the measurement behavior in internal/sprint/performance_measure.go.
theories.confirmation_condition: A deterministic runner fails after executing one or more warmup or sample commands, optimizePerformance omits those executions from state.Counters, and a later cycle is admitted despite actual cumulative executions exceeding state.Limits.Commands.
theories.refutation_condition: Every attempted measurement command, including commands preceding a measurement error, is charged to durable counters or reserved so later cycle admission cannot exceed state.Limits.Commands.
theories.inconclusive_condition: The runner or measurement layer independently enforces the same aggregate command maximum, preventing omitted counter charges from permitting additional subprocess executions.
theories.safe_evidence_strategy: Use a deterministic process-runner double that counts invocations and fails during candidate and already-met remeasurement; compare invocation count, persisted counters, and cycle admission without a real runtime or canonical-worktree mutation.

evidence.summary: Candidate counters are incremented only after MeasurePerformanceTarget succeeds; failed already-met remeasurements continue before their counter increments, while later cycle admission uses state.Counters.Commands.

## Findings

- [low] `TEST-CONTRACT-001-cli-json-golden` Public CLI/API contract compatibility lacks golden output regression for performance commands — TEST-CONTRACT-001 requires compatibility tests for stable request/response shapes, exit codes, and public CLI output when public surfaces change. New surface ultraplan sprint <project> <sprint> performance (dry-run/status/resume/cancel/recover) adds JSON envelopes (schema_version 1) and text modes with distinct exit mapping (target_missed->ExitValidation, cancelled->ExitCancel, etc.). Current coverage validates argument rejection and DTO field presence/absence but provides no golden/compatibility fixture asserting stable JSON envelope, stdout/stderr separation, and exit-code contract that would catch breaking changes.
  - action: Add CLI compatibility fixtures for performance status/dry-run JSON (schema_version, operation, status, result shape, no raw_samples/command_output/profile leak) and text exit-code mapping, using the canonical fixture family already in internal/testdata/performance/states.json.

- [low] `TEST-MIGRATION-001-flow-v4-coverage` FlowState v4 (performance projection) migration lacks dedicated forward-compatibility verification — FlowState schema was bumped to version 4 to add optional performance projection. Persistence contract requires forward/compatibility verification with realistic seed data. Migration code exists (migrateFlowStateV2 handling Previous/Older -> Current) but no dedicated test exercises loading a v3/v2/v1 file containing review/smoke/QA/repair and asserting performance=nil, fresh, and digest-bound pointer validation. PerformanceState itself is v1-only with no downgrade/compatibility case.
  - action: Add a migration fixture test loading real v3/v2 flow-state.json seed, decode via LoadFlowState, assert SchemaVersion==4, performance nil, validation passes, and round-trip save/load preserves pointer safety; add PerformanceState unknown-field/trailing-JSON and digest-mismatch fixtures beyond happy path.

TEST-SMOKE-002 requires at least one real-dependency smoke verifying lifecycle/persistence beyond cosmetic output, or an explicit justified deferral. Implementation tests use only fake process/runtime doubles and execution explicitly defers the gated dogfood. Deferral is documented but leaves the required real-runtime contract unverified for this sprint.
  - action: Run the gated real-runtime dogfood required by requirements AC-11/Technical Requirements (one required absolute target, one required baseline-relative target, one report/baseline target, rejected functional regression, contained accepted improvement or truthful non-acceptance) and link the run; or keep the explicit blocked deferral and prevent promotion until Sprint 40 dogfood.
